subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should transcript terminal-control hardening sanitize the generated human-readable `summary.md`, only the `transcripts show` stdout path, or wait for security triage before changing either boundary?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the choice changes whether stored summary artifacts preserve raw imported text or become terminal-safe display artifacts, and the issue is already public but security-sensitive.

options.title: Sanitize generated summary artifacts
options.body: Strip terminal controls from externally supplied transcript text and speaker labels before writing human-readable summary markdown so both `transcripts show` and direct `summary.md` viewing are safe.

options.title: Sanitize display only
options.body: Protect `openclaw transcripts show` while preserving raw summary files, accepting that direct artifact viewing can still emit controls.

options.title: Pause for security triage
options.body: Hold repair until security reviewers decide whether this already-public terminal-control path needs advisory-style handling or a private patch route.

recommendation.title: Sanitize generated summary artifacts
recommendation.body: Strip terminal controls from externally supplied transcript text and speaker labels before writing human-readable summary markdown so both `transcripts show` and direct `summary.md` viewing are safe.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the core transcript summary/CLI surface and authored adjacent terminal-output hardening, making them the best available owner for the boundary decision.
